title: What is the clinical evidence to support off-label rapamycin therapy in healthy adults?
book_use: Chapter 11; The Rapamycin Underground; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: review of low-dose rapamycin and rapalog evidence in healthy human adults; conclusion that human data have not established rapamycin as a proven therapy that delays aging in healthy older adults; Limits: A review rather than a definitive efficacy trial; the evidence base remains small and heterogeneous.
